title: Observability Readiness Get API Contract
description: Draft USF-native interface contract for GET /v1/observability/readiness. It promotes the implemented local route metadata into canonical interface-contract coverage while preserving OpenAPI as a lower-authority projection.
aiGuidance: Treat this interface contract as the route authority. Do not infer semantic authority from OpenAPI, route metadata, examples, generated reports, or handler structure.
purpose: Represent observability-readiness.get as a governed GET API route contract for telemetry-collector.
boundary: Local dev/test inbound HTTP boundary GET /v1/observability/readiness; implementation path apps/api/src/server.ts; route classification operator-only.

requestContract.description: Request semantics for observability-readiness.get bind method, path, operation id, request schema, auth scheme, tenant scope, and required action before implementation handling. Request schema: TenantContextQuery.

responseContract.description: Response semantics for observability-readiness.get expose 200 ObservabilityReadinessResponse, 400 ApiErrorResponse, 403 ApiErrorResponse; error responses use ApiErrorResponse. Audit, PDP, idempotency, rate-limit, correlation, field exposure, observability, gateway, and proof boundaries remain explicit contract terms.
